physical_host.session: Plasma Wayland, external 3840x2160 60 Hz at 250 percent

runtime.delivery: Per-user Steam, Bottles, Lutris and ProtonUp-Qt installed through Mo Store on the booted image. The candidate Store API and launcher were exercised from the worktree.
runtime.bottles: MoOS Windows gaming environment, sys-wine-11.0, DXVK 3.1.1, VKD3D-Proton 3.1

stalker_call_of_pripyat.scope: Publisher stand-alone benchmark, Windows xrEngine, scripted camera, four publisher weather scripts, one pass each. No campaign, multiplayer or input judgement.
stalker_call_of_pripyat.settings: DX11 renderer_r4, base configuration with Medium preset, windowed, VSync off. Requested 1600x900. DXVK swapchain readback 1542x844.
stalker_call_of_pripyat.runtime_note: Wine logged long critical-section waits and an unavailable EDID. Each scene wrote its own complete general and per-frame results. The desktop was in normal use and background test activity varied.

xonotic.scope: Windows xonotic.exe, timed demo demos/the-big-keybench.dem via native Wine, effects-high, requested 1920x1080, windowed, VSync off
xonotic.repeats: One complete 1080p sample. A separate 720p repeat timed out.

offline_match.client: Windows xonotic.exe, 1280x720, loopback only, online statistics disabled
offline_match.observed: Joined a deathmatch, verified the first-person HUD, a changing scoreboard and six active players including five bots.

supertuxkart.scope: Windows executable, Wine, Vulkan, windowed 1920x1080, 10-kart automated Black Forest race, sound disabled

gravitymark.settings: Windows benchmark via Steam Flatpak Proton runinprefix, 1920x1080, 100000 asteroids, temporal AA, VSync off. One entire pass per API, roughly 167 seconds per scene.
gravitymark.controls: WineD3D fallback averaged 30.9 FPS. A plain Wine D3D11 attempt failed to compile a shader. A direct Proton run outside a game session did not reach the scene. The successful runs selected the compatibility tool’s native graphics DLLs only for the test prefix.

openscad.scope: Windows CAD console under the installed Store lease and prefix. CGAL export of an Arabic-named source via the native short path. The triangles match the previous export regardless of ordering.

peazip.scope: Installed through the booted Mo Store. Ran its receipt-verified Windows 7z backend in the app prefix, created and tested an archive, then extracted the Arabic-named file and compared its 48000 bytes.
peazip.store_launch: A separate launch via the installed Store opened the Windows PeaZip GUI.

qalculate.scope: The installed 1198 recipe returned publisher HTTP 404. The existing Store installed the pinned replacement using the reviewed worktree catalogue. With 60-digit precision the Windows CLI returned the exact integer 2^128. Its default display rounds to 3.402823669E38.
qalculate.store_launch: A separate launch via the installed Store opened the Windows Qt calculator with its keypad and expression field.

file_manager_to_consent.scope: Seven interleaved runs per revision after one warmup each, actual Windows game PE and installed resolver. The same test dialogue declined folder access. This measures dispatch until consent, excluding game startup.

fc26.local: Unsupported. Publisher requires EA Javelin kernel anti-cheat. No local match was played.

steam.scope: The measurements cover Windows payloads on this AMD V3. A Steam library match, 4K performance, anti-cheat multiplayer, ARM and NVIDIA machines each need separate qualification.

project_warlock_demo.scope: The desktop client received the install URI and its launch returned AppError_18. No local game manifest at the time of review. Valve SteamCMD also refused anonymous installation with No subscription. No play result.

windows_catalogue.method: HTTPS HEAD against each x86_64 Windows recipe after the Qalculate fix. This checks the published URL and size. The Store verified the downloaded bytes for the two fresh installations.
